summary: Akanda Corp. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Interim CEO and Executive Director Katie Field resigned effective September 3, 2026, with no cited disagreement over operations, policies or practices. The board appointed existing director Christopher Cooper, 56, also president of subsidiary First Towers and Fiber Corp., as CEO the same day, effective September 3, 2026. Akanda entered a month-to-month consulting agreement on September 9, 2026 with a Field affiliate for administrative and advisory services. Cooper holds no employment agreement but receives First Towers compensation, $196,000 for fiscal 2025 plus CAD$5,000 monthly. Watch for leadership continuity risk and further board or strategic changes given the abrupt transition.
